recognize_zh: 低中倍稀薄抹片中散布數個大型、胞質嗜鹼性的芽細胞與單核球樣細胞，另有核分葉不良、顆粒稀少的嗜中性球與晚期紅血球前驅細胞；可提示芽細胞增加與顆粒球發育不良，但倍率低，細節有限。
features: Scattered large blasts with round nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm
Hypogranular neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation (lower center)
Occasional late erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
Hemodilute field with abundant red cells; resolution limits assessment of dysplasia
describe_en: Hemodilute smear at low-to-medium power shows scattered large blasts with round nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, monocytoid cells with folded nuclei, occasional late erythroid precursors, and small lymphocytes. A neutrophil with hypogranular cytoplasm and abnormal nuclear segmentation is present. The magnification and hemodilution limit reliable assessment of multilineage dysplasia and blast percentage. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with dysplastic features and should be correlated with a cellular aspirate and genetic studies for classification as AML with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥20% monocytic lineage cells confirmed by NSE or flow cytometry (CD14, CD64).
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes, which must be established on a full differential count.
Separated from AML solely by blast percentage below 20%.
